messages:
ravi: Quick idea: call the migration pattern 'bridges' to frame adapters + incentives together. propose three bridges: instant opt-in, negotiated window (30d), legacy grace (180d). Thoughts?
emma: I like the framing. Does negotiated include credits?
carlos: yes — recommend 2 free migration credits + sales can augment. keeps friction low.
jordan: runtime note: each bridge needs a telemetry flag and optional adapter sidecar. sidecar is safest for rollback.
ops-bot: FYI model retention default = 90 days. request infra ticket if we need 180-day artifacts.
cs_olivia: customers want a one-click console test and visible calendar. We'll prepare sample prompts and UI copy.
emma: acceptance gates: small/beta=250, canary=1k, full=5k. gate metrics: p95 latency delta <25%, error rate delta <0.2pp, primary quality drop <1.5% absolute.
ravi: pin policy: soft-pin (recommended) vs hard-pin (contracted). suggest pin TTL defaults: free=90d, enterprise=180d. tenant-admin can renew.
carlos: legal needs exact wording for hard-pin obligations. I'll open intake.
jordan: shim spec: minimal transforms first (tokenizer, param mapping), then response shape. will prototype sidecar adapter.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-3201 (extend model retention for bridge plan).
cs_olivia: comms cadence: pre-announce 60d, validation window w/ test harness, migration week. negotiated bridge gets explicit invite + credits.
emma: rollout cadence: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, hold if gates fail. each stage min 24h.
ravi: action items: carlos draft credit/legal blurb, jordan spike shim, emma update rollout playbook, olivia prepare test-harness copy. I'll collate into RFC by Friday.
carlos: on it.
jordan: will open PR for adapter spec.
emma: adding metric thresholds to playbook now.
cs_olivia: will share sample prompt pack for top 10 customers.
ravi: tagging @sales for awareness on credits/offers. no objections?
carlos: none.
jordan: none.
emma: none.
cs_olivia: none.
